drafted_from: tool:github:tesseract-ocr-tesseract's row in tools/tools-from-github/tool-rows.json (job, run, get_it, needs) and its sources row in sources.json; the command is the row's own run line with synthetic names filled in. What it prints or writes is read from the tool's documented behavior; the folder test test/index-github-tools.test.mjs only checks the row, never runs tesseract.
start_here: Say to your AI: "Use tesseract on my computer to read the text in an image or a scan (OCR): the file is receipt.png." It reads the row, installs tesseract if it is missing, runs it on that one file and shows you what it made.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: tesseract is a program that runs on the person's own computer and works on the one file or address it is handed.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Use tesseract on receipt.png". It reads the row with run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools, method tools:list, input {tool: "tool:github:tesseract-ocr-tesseract"}.

2. It checks that nothing else is on your computer, and if tesseract is missing it runs the get_it steps: git clone https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract.git ; brew install tesseract (macOS), or apt install tesseract-ocr (Linux).
3. It runs the row's command with your file in place of {input} and where the result goes in place of {output}: tesseract receipt.png receipt
4. Read what it shows you and open the result. Trillion runs none of this; it all happens on your own computer.

worked_examples.title: tesseract on a photo of a paper receipt from a bakery
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/tools-from-github/tool-rows.json: tool:github:tesseract-ocr-tesseract runs on your computer, so after tools:list the AI runs, in the folder it got tesseract in, the command line: tesseract receipt.png receipt  (synthetic input: a photo of a paper receipt from a bakery).
worked_examples.hands_back: tesseract prints nothing and writes receipt.txt (it adds the .txt itself): the lines of text it read from the photo, for example "Sam's Bakery / 2 loaves 8.00 / Total 8.00".
